skill_name: Develop a strategy for learning a new language in a short amount of time.
workflow: A strategy for learning a language quickly involves using a combination of different methods. Start by establishing the primary goals of what you want to learn, such as reading, listening, speaking, or writing. This will give you an overall framework to build on. Then, begin by learning the basics such as pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary.
